$comment: Maps a Benchlee catalog model slug (db/seed/catalog.json) to the concrete API
model id scripts/run-benchmark.mjs should call, plus pricing so cost_usd can be
These ids are EXAMPLES. Set them to model ids your account actually has, and
check current pricing with your provider — the numbers below are placeholders
and will be wrong the moment prices change. A model with no entry here, or with
no API key in the environment, is skipped rather than faked.
usd_per_mtok_in / usd_per_mtok_out are US dollars per 1,000,000 tokens.
